mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant negative correlation between GDPC1 declines and S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05), or the signal fails to predict negative returns in at least 60% of triggered periods.
